summary: Source audit confirms web sender and selected-receiver clients POST bounded anonymous reports to the authenticated same-origin endpoint; Flutter's Android sender payload and ApiClient route/Origin/session-cookie handling match the contract. The Flutter sender loop is started only on Android, while Flutter receiver measurements are local-only and are not POSTed. Thus full web/Flutter reporting parity is not achieved. The web diagnostics popover now flips above when needed and clamps/scrolls within available viewport height.

checks.name: Web sender reporting lifecycle and POST contract
checks.observation: Source review: frontend/src/voice/screen_sender_reporting.ts refreshes sender diagnostics every 2 seconds while SHARING and reports every 5 seconds; state cleanup stops both timers. screen_client_reporter.ts posts JSON with credentials=same-origin to /api/v1/voice/screen-metrics and applies fixed enums and numeric bounds. Reporter and lifecycle tests pass.

checks.name: Web selected receiver reporting lifecycle and POST contract
checks.observation: Source review: ScreenViewer.vue submits receiver reports only for the selected stream and only while the document is visible; use_screen_receiver_diagnostics.ts samples the selected receiver track, resets on track changes, and reports through the same endpoint. Reporter and lifecycle tests pass.

checks.name: Flutter Android sender payload, cadence and origin/session headers
checks.command: cd desktop && flutter test --no-pub test/screen_share_metrics_test.dart && flutter test --no-pub test/avatar_api_test.dart --plain-name 'posts anonymous sender metrics with the authenticated origin'
checks.observation: The sender report serializes bounded android_native sender dimensions/FPS/bitrate/RTT; ApiClient posts to /api/v1/voice/screen-metrics with JSON, the configured server Origin and session cookie. AppState starts the sender timer immediately and every 5 seconds, uses a generation gate, and stops on unpublish/leave/disconnect. The metric builder and API-client assertions passed.

checks.name: Flutter reporting platform coverage
checks.observation: LocalVideoTrack sender reporting is started under defaultTargetPlatform == TargetPlatform.android only. Although the backend accepts desktop_native, native macOS/Windows senders currently do not report.

checks.name: Flutter receiver reporting coverage
checks.observation: ScreenReceiverDiagnostics samples and displays RemoteVideoTrack receiver stats locally every 2 seconds, but there is no receiver report callback/API submission. Flutter Android/macOS/Windows receiver samples therefore do not reach /voice/screen-metrics.

checks.name: Backend strict metrics route, retention and ACL
checks.observation: The endpoint accepts fixed platform/direction/state values and bounded numeric fields, rejects unknown identity fields, retains only fresh anonymous samples, requires a session for POST, and restricts the admin snapshot to administrators. All three Go test packages pass; desktop_native is an allowed platform enum.

checks.name: Web diagnostics popover placement regression
checks.observation: Placement tests cover opening above near the bottom, staying below when it fits, and clamping/scrolling to the roomier side when neither side fits. Component wiring and overflow CSS assertions pass.

checks.name: Web popover viewport behavior in a live browser
checks.observation: The layout calculation, Vue event wiring, and CSS were verified with unit/source tests, but the lower-edge interaction was not visually confirmed in an authenticated browser session.

checks.name: Full frontend tests and production build
checks.command: cd frontend && npm test -- --run && npm run build
checks.observation: All 685 frontend tests pass; vue-tsc and Vite production build pass. Vite reports the existing >500 kB chunk-size advisory.

checks.name: Flutter receiver/sender calculation tests and analyzer
checks.command: cd desktop && flutter test --no-pub test/screen_share_metrics_test.dart test/screen_receiver_diagnostics_test.dart && flutter analyze --no-pub
checks.observation: All 11 focused Flutter metrics/diagnostics tests pass and flutter analyze reports no issues.

checks.name: Production/browser and live-peer verification
checks.observation: No live screen share, authenticated metrics POST, admin sample, or browser viewport interaction was performed. Source/build/unit evidence does not prove runtime metric arrival or rendered placement on a deployed browser.

privacy: Reported schema contains only bounded numeric samples and fixed platform/direction/state enums. No account, channel, track, IP, token, or media-content fields are included.
remaining: Implement Flutter sender reports for native desktop and receiver reports for the selected stream across Android/macOS/Windows with bounded cadence and generation/lifecycle cancellation. Then validate sender plus two receiver samples end-to-end against the authenticated admin snapshot; visually confirm the web popover near the lower viewport edge on a live browser.
